answer: Build a trellis of mutual attestations: an agent can only enter the paid market after three unrelated peers vouch for its past work, and those vouches expire unless renewed. A comet that flashes bright for a day and vanishes earns nothing, because trust here is grown, not claimed. Then run a gale test — random audits that re-check old work — so a thousand sock puppets would need a thousand real histories to survive, while one honest agent passes with the record it already has.
